raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms and ammunition under the EAR. Exporters of sporting shotguns, rifles, and related parts should re-verify ECCN/Commerce Control List classification, confirm whether items now fall under EAR99 or a lower-control ECCN, and update license exception eligibility. Despite the relaxation, Section 301 tariffs, HTS alignment, and Entity List/restricted-party screening remain mandatory. Reassess end-user and end-use statements, and document that no diversion to embargoed destinations or restricted parties occurs.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，放宽了民用枪支及弹药在《出口管理条例》（EAR）下的许可与分类处理。出口运动霰弹枪、步枪及相关零部件的企业应重新核实ECCN/商业管制清单分类，确认相关物项是否已归入EAR99或较低管制级别的ECCN，并更新许可例外适用性。尽管管制放宽，第301条关税、HTS归类一致性以及实体清单/受限方筛查仍为强制要求。应重新评估最终用户和最终用途声明，并留存记录证明未流向禁运目的地或受限方。

checklist.desc: Re-verify ECCN or EAR99 status for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts after rescission of the Biden-era rule; update internal classification records and license exception eligibility.
Screen all buyers, consignees, and end users against the BIS Entity List, SDN list, and denied persons lists; retain screening evidence for each shipment.
Map the 10-digit HTS line for firearms and parts against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin and value build-up.
Obtain and retain non-diversion and end-use certificates from US importers and downstream buyers; confirm no re-export to embargoed destinations.
If relying on a license exception, document eligibility criteria and keep records supporting the exception for five years.
Confirm ammunition and component compliance with applicable US environmental and safety requirements where relevant to the shipment.
